name: Amber Fort
description: A majestic hilltop fort known for its artistic Hindu style elements and panoramic views of Maota Lake.

name: City Palace
description: An opulent palace complex blending Rajput and Mughal architecture with museums showcasing royal artifacts.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: The iconic 'Palace of Winds' with its honeycomb façade designed for royal ladies to observe street festivities unseen.

name: Jantar Mantar
description: An 18th-century astronomical observatory with large instruments to measure time, predict eclipses, and track stars.

name: Nahargarh Fort
description: A fort offering stunning sunset views over Jaipur and a glimpse into royal leisure life with its palace and gardens.

name: Jaigarh Fort
description: Known as the 'Fort of Victory', it houses the world's largest cannon on wheels and offers panoramic views.

name: Albert Hall Museum
description: A grand Indo-Saracenic building housing an extensive collection of artifacts, paintings, and sculptures.

name: Galta Ji (Monkey Temple)
description: A sacred Hindu pilgrimage site with natural springs, ancient temples, and a large population of playful monkeys.

name: Chokhi Dhani
description: A vibrant ethnic village resort offering traditional Rajasthani food, folk dances, camel rides, and crafts.

name: Sisodia Rani Garden
description: A beautifully landscaped garden with fountains, painted pavilions, and terraces built for the queen.

name: Panna Meena ka Kund
description: A stunning stepwell with symmetrical staircases and intricate architecture, a hidden gem near Amber Fort.

name: Raj Mandir Cinema
description: An iconic movie palace known for its lavish interiors and a quintessential Bollywood cinema experience.

name: Jawahar Kala Kendra
description: A cultural center showcasing Rajasthani arts, crafts, and performing arts in a unique architectural setting.

name: Central Park Jaipur
description: A large urban park with lush greenery, jogging tracks, and a musical fountain, perfect for relaxation.

name: Nahargarh Biological Park
description: A wildlife sanctuary near Nahargarh Fort featuring native species and a serene natural environment.

name: Kanak Vrindavan
description: A peaceful garden with fountains, murals depicting Krishna's life, and a tranquil atmosphere near Nahargarh Fort.

name: Rajputana Museum
description: A museum dedicated to Rajput history and culture with weapons, costumes, and artifacts on display.

name: Vintage Car Museum
description: A unique collection of vintage and classic cars owned by the Jaipur royal family, showcasing automotive history.

name: Bapu Bazaar
description: A bustling market famous for textiles, handicrafts, jewelry, and traditional Rajasthani goods.

name: Johari Bazaar
description: A historic market renowned for exquisite jewelry, gemstones, and traditional Rajasthani crafts.
